# ubuntu_user Resource

Manages a user resource via the executor.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "ubuntu_user" "example" {
  target = var.host
  name = "example"
}
```
## Argument Reference

The resource supports the following arguments:

- `allow_destructive_destroy` (Optional, bool) - Explicitly allow destructive destroy for protected or side-effecting host objects managed by this resource.
- `comment` (Optional, string) - GECOS comment field.
- `ensure` (Optional, Computed, string) - Desired user outcome (present or absent). Defaults to present.
- `gid` (Optional, Computed, int64) - Primary group ID.
- `groups` (Optional, list(string)) - Supplementary groups.
- `home` (Optional, Computed, string) - Home directory path.
- `name` (Required, string) - Username.
- `port` (Optional, int64) - Target port for this resource. Overrides provider default_target.port.
- `remove_home` (Optional, bool) - Remove the home directory when ensuring the user is absent.
- `run_as` (Optional, string) - Run commands as this user.
- `shell` (Optional, Computed, string) - Login shell.
- `system` (Optional, bool) - Whether this is a system user.
- `target` (Optional, string) - Target host or address for this resource. Overrides provider default_target.target.
- `transport` (Optional, string) - Transport for this resource. The current provider surface supports ssh.
- `uid` (Optional, Computed, int64) - User ID.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes:

- `id` (string) - Unique identifier for this resource.
